property_summary: At rest, the contract's ether holdings must equal the sum of recorded user balances; the mutant, lacking the reentrancy lock, lets a re-entrant addToBalance deposit fresh ETH mid-withdrawal while zeroing the balance, so getBalance(attacker)=0 but address(c).balance>0.
change_summary: Delete setting locked_ to true, disabling the reentrancy guard so a reentrant withdrawBalance can send funds twice before the balance is reset.
